findings.evidence: AB14a's Mitigation cell says 'the backup key is not in object storage, it exists only on the VM and in the team's offline store (jade-lnn.1, jade-fgs)'. The same committed document says otherwise in three places. TB9 says the restore drill 'needs the production backup key there' (staging). The diagram has an edge SECRETS_OFFLINE -> STAGING labelled 'backup key for the drill'. TM-3 says 'the production backup key is used there'. A p9-authz-sweep (jade-sio) reader checking AB14a would be told the key exists in only two places. In fact a third host (staging, which otherwise 'uses its own secrets' per p1-staging) holds it at least during the drill, and a staging compromise then exposes the 30 days of backups. jade-fgs's 'Secrets exist only on the server and in the team's offline store' does not decide whether the staging VM counts as 'the server'.
findings.fix: In AB14a, write 'exists on the production VM and in the team's offline store (jade-lnn.1, jade-fgs), and is used on the staging VM for the restore drill (jade-6o3, TM-3)'. Alternatively, add a sentence under the table that AB14a assumes the key is removed from staging after the drill, which TM-3 leaves open. AC9 still holds, because jade-6o3 is already in the Phase cell.
